cohort: The study included 37 pregnant/postpartum COVID-19 cases admitted to the intensive care unit between March 1, 2020, and December 1, 2021.
finding: The study found a high mortality rate (54.1%) among pregnant/postpartum COVID-19 patients in the ICU, with 36 out of 37 patients being unvaccinated, and suggested that ECMO may be effective in recovery of oxygenation.
